form.label: CVE impact overview
form.description: New Rapid7 checks (by date added) and how many of your Active servers they affect: Prod (DC / DR), Non-prod (UAT / SIT / DEV) and INFRA. Rollup checks that list more than 20 CVEs are left out unless you include them. Figures come from lookups refreshed hourly by "Rapid7 CVE - recent checks lookup" (:20) and "recent hits lookup" (:30).

search.query: | inputlookup r7_recent_hits.csv | search cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" env_label="$env$" $sev$ $rollup$ | where added_e>=relative_time(now(),"-7d@d") | stats dc(eval(if(like(cve,"ROLLUP:%"),null(),cve))) as cves dc(eval(if(env_group="Prod",asset_id,null()))) as prod dc(eval(if(env_group="Non-prod",asset_id,null()))) as nonprod dc(eval(if(env_label="INFRA",asset_id,null()))) as infra
| inputlookup r7_recent_checks.csv | search $sev$ rollup=0 | where added_e>=relative_time(now(),"-1d@d") | eval cve=split(cves_str,"|") | mvexpand cve | where cve!="" | stats dc(cve) as cves
| inputlookup r7_recent_checks.csv | search $sev$ rollup=0 | where added_e>=relative_time(now(),"-7d@d") | eval cve=split(cves_str,"|") | mvexpand cve | where cve!="" | stats dc(cve) as cves

single.title: New CVEs affecting your servers (7 d)

search.query: `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_site)` | dedup asset_id | stats count(eval(credentialed="true")) as with_sw count as total | eval coverage=round(with_sw/total*100,1) | fields coverage

table.title: New CVEs in Rapid7 (added in the last 7 days) and your affected Active servers

search.query: | inputlookup r7_recent_checks.csv | search $sev$ $rollup$ | where added_e>=relative_time(now(),"-7d@d") | eval cve=if(rollup=1, "ROLLUP:".vuln_id, split(cves_str,"|")) | mvexpand cve | stats values(vuln_id) as rapid7_checks first(title) as title first(severity) as severity max(cvss_v3) as cvss_v3 min(published) as published min(added) as added max(modified) as modified max(cve_count) as cves_in_check by cve | join type=left cve [| inputlookup r7_recent_hits.csv | search cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" env_label="$env$" | stats dc(asset_id) as your_servers dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DC",asset_id,null()))) as prod_dc dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DR",asset_id,null()))) as prod_dr dc(eval(if(env_group="Non-prod",asset_id,null()))) as non_prod dc(eval(if(env_label="INFRA",asset_id,null()))) as infra by cve] | fillnull value=0 your_servers prod_dc prod_dr non_prod infra | sort - prod_dc - prod_dr - your_servers - cvss_v3 | table cve rapid7_checks title severity cvss_v3 published added modified your_servers prod_dc prod_dr non_prod infra | rename prod_dc as "Prod · DC" prod_dr as "Prod · DR" non_prod as "Non-prod" infra as "INFRA"

table.title: Software inventory coverage by environment (servers with software data = credentialed scan or Insight Agent)

search.query: `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_site)` | dedup asset_id | `r7_cmdb_enrich` | where cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" OR cmdb_status="NOT_IN_CMDB" | stats count as servers count(eval(credentialed="true")) as with_software_data by env_label | eval without=servers-with_software_data, coverage_pct=round(with_software_data/servers*100,1) | eval sort_order=case(env_label="Prod · DC",1, env_label="Prod · DR",2, like(env_label,"Non-prod%"),3, env_label="INFRA",4, true(),5) | sort sort_order env_label | fields - sort_order

| rest /servicesNS/-/rapid7_vm_cve/saved/searches splunk_server=local | search title IN ("Rapid7 CVE - recent checks lookup","Rapid7 CVE - recent hits lookup") | table title cron_schedule next_scheduled_time | append [| inputlookup r7_recent_checks.csv | stats count as rows | eval title="r7_recent_checks.csv (checks added in 30 days)"] | append [| inputlookup r7_recent_hits.csv | stats count as rows | eval title="r7_recent_hits.csv (server × CVE findings)"]
